qt: to the Commission Fabio De Masi (NI) Subject:

What is the position of the Commission on German Chancellor Friedrich Merz's call for a global minimum level of taxation of groups of companies in the EU to be suspended (EU Directive 2022/2523), and is it planning to act to ensure that the directive continues to be implemented?1
at: (English version) to the Commission Fabio De Masi (NI) (16 July 2025) Subject: Position on calls for suspension of a global minimum level of taxation in the EU What is the position of the Commission on German Chancellor Friedrich Merz's call for a global minimum level of taxation of groups of companies in the EU to be suspended (EU Directive 2022/2523), and is it planning to act to ensure that the directive continues to be implemented? (1) (26 August 2025) The Commission does not comment on statements made by national Governments. EU Directive 2022/2523 of 14 December 2022 on ensuring a global minimum level of taxation for multinational enterprise groups and large-scale domestic groups in the EU is EU law and is implemented as laid down in the legislation.
